def partition(arr, low, high):
    pivot = arr[high]
    i = (low - 1)

    for j in range(low, high):

  if (!is.numeric(data)) {
    stop("Input data must be numeric.")
  }

def max_path_sum(matrix):
    rows = len(matrix)
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    
    # Initialize the first row and column with their values
    dp = matrix.copy()
    for i in range(1, rows):
        dp[i][0] += dp[i-1][0]
    for j in range(1, cols):
        dp[0][j] += dp[0][j-1]
    
    # Fill the DP table
    for i in range(1, rows):
        for j in range(1, cols):
            dp[i][j] += max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
    
    # The maximum path sum will be in the bottom-right cell of the DP table
    return dp[-1][-1]
